name: fred_consumer_sentiment
description:
The University of Michigan consumer sentiment index from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series UMCSENT (index 1966:Q1=100, monthly).
Returns {"series": "UMCSENT", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; omitted: 60, although the schema default says 30).
Related: fred_retail_sales, fred_leading_index; for any other FRED series use fred_custom_series.
Example: {"limit": 12}
API key: env FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); when unset the placeholder DEMO_KEY is sent.

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
